item.title: Studio Sofield Works at The Wolfsonian
item.description: Miami, FL - February 26, 2026 - A Very Wolfsonian Weekend kicked off with Night One celebrating 30 years of The Wolfsonian. William Sofield and Emma O’Neill explored the multidisciplinary work of Studio Sofield in conversation with new Wolfsonian curator Danielle Charlap, offering insight into the studio’s design legacy. item.description: Miami, FL - February 26, 2024 - Christie’s has opened its new Miami headquarters in the heart of the Design District. This week, Christie’s Watches, Handbags, and Gooding Christie’s are presenting a curated selection of pieces available for direct purchase through Private Sales.
